claims.claim: Unsupervised SimCSE uses independent dropout masks as the only augmentation for two views of a sentence.
claims.verification_note: No word substitution or external augmentation is required.

claims.claim: Supervised SimCSE uses NLI entailment positives and contradiction hard negatives.
claims.verification_note: Do not conflate neutral with contradiction labels.

claims.claim: SimCSE trains sentence vectors with an in-batch contrastive InfoNCE objective using temperature.
claims.verification_note: Column/candidate softmax with positive diagonal, tutorial writes one directional loss.

claims.claim: Paper abstract reports 76.3 and 81.6 Spearman STS values for specific unsupervised/supervised BERT-base settings.
claims.verification_note: Not Chinese dataset performance or retrieval Recall@k.

claims.claim: Princeton code documents multiple pooling modes and use of dropout in training.
claims.verification_note: Pooling choice is checkpoint- and evaluation-dependent.

claims.claim: The encoder returns token states [B,T,H] before sentence pooling.
claims.verification_note: Mean pooling on padded input must use attention masks.
